title: Camping
hook: 一家人去露营，帐篷太小装不下猪爸爸，他只好睡在帐篷外的星空下。

cells.q: What is the family doing today?
cells.a: They are going camping out in the countryside.
cells.cn: 他们今天要去乡下露营。

cells.q: What did they say about the tent?
cells.a: They said the tent is a bit little for all of them.
cells.cn: 他们说这顶帐篷全家住有点小。

cells.a: First they have to collect sticks to make a fire.
cells.cn: 首先他们得捡树枝生火。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She asked how he can light the fire without matches.
cells.cn: 她问没有火柴他怎么点火。

cells.a: Now they can heat up the tomato soup on the fire.
cells.cn: 现在他们可以在火上热番茄汤了。

cells.q: What sound did Daddy Pig say is nice?
cells.a: He said his tummy rumbling is a sound of nature.
cells.cn: 他说自己肚子咕咕叫也是大自然的声音。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say about the little tent?
cells.a: He said, “It will be fine! In you go!”
cells.cn: 他说：“没问题的！你进去吧！”

cells.q: How was the tent at night?
cells.a: It was lovely and cozy for Mummy and the children.
cells.cn: 妈妈和孩子在帐篷里又暖又舒服。

cells.a: He slept in the car, but he says he is an expert.
cells.cn: 他睡在车里，却说自己可是露营高手。
